justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Low vision rehabilitation improves ADL performance and reading for patients with visual impairment.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ACVREP CLVT requires experience plus exam; moderate investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable exclusively to low vision rehabilitation and vision impairment populations; very narrow clinical scope.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: CLVT enables billing for low vision rehabilitation under vision rehab CPT codes; Medicare Part B and some commercial cover.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Consistent demand in low vision programs and vision rehabilitation centers; specialized but stable.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Visual impairment significantly impacts QoL; effective rehabilitation is highly meaningful.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Low vision services are overwhelmingly reimbursed through Medicare/insurance or VA; consumers rarely pay cash for vision rehab.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Niche scarcity gives some leverage but reimbursement caps and a non-affluent patient population limit premium pricing.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Genuinely rare credential; few OTs hold it, so it stands out clearly in any market.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Could staff a small specialty arm if you can recruit other CLVTs, though the talent pool is thin.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers don't shop for 'low vision therapy' directly; referrals come from ophthalmology, not the public.
justifications.business.efficiency: Requires significant supervised hours and coursework through ACVREP; slow and expensive path.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Recognized as a legitimate specialty cert in OT academia but not a marquee credential for promotion.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Modest publishing community; respectable but small literature base.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly maps to OT curricular content on vision, ADLs, and aging; useful instructor credential.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Moderate evidence base with practice guidelines but limited large RCTs.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally preferred for OT faculty teaching vision/geriatrics content, rarely required.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: ACVREP pathway is time-intensive relative to its academic payoff.
